en.headline: Didi plans autonomous vehicle tests in Tseung Kwan O this year
en.dek: A government adviser said the mainland ride-hailing firm will apply for a pilot licence, with initial trials likely starting in the industrial estate.
body: Mainland Chinese ride-hailing company Didi Chuxing intends to apply this year for an autonomous vehicle pilot licence in Hong Kong, with initial tests planned for Tseung Kwan O, according to a member of the Transport Department’s working group on autonomous vehicles.

Gary Zhang Xinyu said on a radio programme on Monday that the industrial estate offered a suitable starting point because of its wider roads, lower traffic volume and relatively simple environment. He noted that Tseung Kwan O also includes the town centre and Lohas Park, which present different road conditions.

The comments followed a visit last Wednesday by Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan and lawmakers to Didi’s Beijing headquarters. Didi is recruiting test drivers for Tseung Kwan O roles at monthly salaries of HK$21,000 to HK$22,000, according to a job posting.

zh.headline: 滴滴擬今年申請將軍澳無人駕駛測試牌照
zh.dek: 運輸署工作組成員表示，內地網約車巨頭擬申請自動車先導牌照，初步測試或先於工業邨展開。
body: 內地網約車平台滴滴出行有意於今年內向運輸署申請自動車先導牌照，並計劃在將軍澳展開測試。運輸署自動駕駛車輛應用促進工作組成員張欣宇周一在電台節目表示，將軍澳工業邨道路較闊、車流量較低、環境相對簡單，適合作為起步點。
他指出，將軍澳範圍涵蓋市中心、康城及工業邨，路況各有不同。有關消息是在運輸及物流局局長陳美寶與立法會議員上周三到訪滴滴北京總部後傳出。
滴滴現正招聘將軍澳測試司機，月薪介乎港幣二萬一千至二萬二千元。張欣宇期望未來可結合網約平台，形成新商業模式。
